question: Does the MEGA bt7 server used by transfer.it actually clamp transfer expiry to 90 days, as the seed claimed, and if so on which endpoint?
why: the first-party transferit-py source and reverse-engineering note on 2026-11-19 show a 10-year client-side clamp and a server that accepts up to ~2^32 seconds, neither of which confirms a 90-day server clamp; no first-party source states a 90-day limit
